mutations.name: choose-entries-shared
mutations.what: the entries handed out are the ones the checkpoint holds, so changing one changes the checkpoint

mutations.name: choose-subset-ignored-when-null
mutations.what: a request for everything (null) is not recognised, so the list is walked and fails

mutations.name: choose-subset-ignored-when-undefined
mutations.what: a request that does not mention a subset is not a request for everything

mutations.name: choose-no-dedup
mutations.what: a path named twice is two entries, so the file is restored twice

mutations.name: choose-dedup-forgets
mutations.what: a path is never remembered as seen

mutations.name: choose-held-not-folded
mutations.what: the held paths are compared as they are spelled, so a case-folding comparison finds nothing

mutations.name: choose-asked-not-folded
mutations.what: the asked paths are compared as they are spelled

mutations.name: choose-unknown-dropped
mutations.what: a path the checkpoint does not hold is skipped without a word

mutations.name: choose-unknown-as-compared
mutations.what: a path that is not held is named as it was compared (lower case), not as it was asked for

mutations.name: choose-entry-spelled-as-asked
mutations.what: an entry takes the spelling of the request instead of the one the checkpoint has

mutations.name: classify-always-asked
mutations.what: a preview is classified as if expectations were given, so it cannot be made

patches.old: const asked = expected !== null && expected !== undefined;

mutations.name: classify-undefined-is-asked
mutations.what: no expectation at all (undefined) is not recognised as a preview

patches.old: const asked = expected !== null && expected !== undefined;

mutations.name: classify-absent-has-a-sha
mutations.what: a file that must be absent is given the sha field of the entry, which it does not have

mutations.name: classify-unseen-is-undefined
mutations.what: a file nobody looked at has no sha rather than the sha of a missing file

mutations.name: classify-unchanged-inverted
mutations.what: a file that is already right is the one that is written

mutations.name: classify-remove-is-overwrite
mutations.what: a created file is overwritten instead of removed

mutations.name: classify-recreate-is-overwrite
mutations.what: a deleted file is overwritten instead of recreated

mutations.name: classify-inherited-expectation
mutations.what: an expectation the object merely inherits is believed

mutations.name: classify-expected-case
mutations.what: a sha written in capitals is another sha

mutations.name: classify-conflict-for-unchanged
mutations.what: a file that is already right is a conflict when it is not what was expected

mutations.name: classify-conflict-without-expectation
mutations.what: a file nobody said anything about is a conflict

mutations.name: classify-conflict-inverted
mutations.what: the file that is what was expected is the conflict

mutations.name: classify-missing-expectation-hidden
mutations.what: an entry without an expectation is not marked

mutations.name: classify-missing-expectation-in-preview
mutations.what: a preview, which expects nothing, is marked as missing its expectations

mutations.name: lower-null-crashes
mutations.what: an expectation of null (the file must not be there) is lower-cased as if it were text

mutations.name: plan-conflicts-are-the-others
mutations.what: the files that are not conflicts are listed as conflicts

mutations.name: plan-applies-conflicts
mutations.what: a conflict is applied too, over the file that changed

mutations.name: plan-applies-unchanged
mutations.what: a file that is already right is written again

mutations.name: plan-unchanged-inverted
mutations.what: the files that are not right are listed as unchanged

mutations.name: plan-never-aborts
mutations.what: a conflict never stops the request

mutations.name: plan-always-aborts
mutations.what: skip does not skip

mutations.name: plan-aborts-without-conflicts
mutations.what: a request without a conflict is stopped

mutations.name: plan-unknown-mode-goes-on
mutations.what: a mode nobody defined is treated as skip

mutations.name: plan-default-is-skip
mutations.what: the default is to go on without the conflicts

mutations.name: same-is-always-true
mutations.what: a file is always taken to be what it was expected to be

mutations.name: same-compares-length
mutations.what: two files are the same when they are the same length

mutations.name: same-null-is-anything
mutations.what: a missing file and a file that is there count as the same

mutations.name: read-swallows-errors
mutations.what: a file that cannot be read is a file that is not there

mutations.name: write-no-folder
mutations.what: a file is written without making the folders it needs

mutations.name: write-leaves-temp
mutations.what: the temporary file is not cleaned up after a failed rename

mutations.name: write-no-rename
mutations.what: the temporary file is never put in place

mutations.name: apply-no-recheck
mutations.what: a file is written without looking again at what it is

mutations.name: apply-stale-is-a-server-error
mutations.what: a file that changed meanwhile is reported as a server error

mutations.name: apply-removal-writes
mutations.what: a file that must go is written instead of removed

mutations.name: apply-forgets-what-it-did
mutations.what: the operations done are not remembered, so nothing is put back

mutations.name: apply-no-read-back
mutations.what: the files are not read back after they are written

mutations.name: apply-read-back-not-flagged
mutations.what: a failed read-back is not recorded as one

mutations.name: apply-never-partial
mutations.what: something that could not be put back is not reported as a partial failure

mutations.name: apply-partial-also-after-read-back
mutations.what: a failed read-back with something that cannot be put back is reported as a partial failure

mutations.name: apply-stale-becomes-rolled-back
mutations.what: a stale file is reported as a failed write

mutations.name: apply-read-back-becomes-rolled-back
mutations.what: a failed read-back is reported as a failed write

mutations.name: rollback-same-order
mutations.what: the files are put back first to last

mutations.name: rollback-overwrites-edits
mutations.what: a file somebody changed meanwhile is put back over

mutations.name: rollback-created-written
mutations.what: a file that was made by the restore is written back as null instead of removed

patches.old: if (op.previous === null) await io.unlink(op.absolute); else await write(io, op.absolute, op.previous);

mutations.name: result-without-sha
mutations.what: the answer does not say what sha each file has now

mutations.name: result-wrong-action
mutations.what: the answer calls every operation an overwrite
